options.text: Decompose the critical path and allocate a latency budget to the work that affects user-visible completion. In this normal path for media metadata, tail latency is the sum of dependent work and queueing, so optimization must target the limiting segment. The owner must also make a lagging derived projection observable rather than silently passing it to another layer.
Choose the nearest familiar component and let each caller decide critical-path decomposition and latency budgets independently, without a shared owner or failure contract.
